data.overview: Cursed by a raging boar spirit, a young prince journeys west seeking a cure. There he finds a fierce forest guardian defending her home and an iron-willed leader determined to clear it; he must bridge their struggle before both sides are lost.
data.tagline: The forest's future rests on one warrior's choice.
data.title: Princess of the Wildwood
